decided: The plan was already finished: /Users/hosoo/.studio-zero/specimens/2026-11-21/toesa-check/.sz/plan/screens/DONE exists. This run wrote nothing and changed nothing. The screen ids come from the 18 files in .sz/plan/screens/, and the list comes from sections 2 and 10 of .sz/plan/frame.md.
The owner was not asked anything before this run. Each point below is the cautious choice the earlier run made and marked (정함) in the frame. The owner can change any of them after seeing the drawing.

No payment: every screen and document is free, and no screen shows a price or a 'paid' label. The owner's paid structure (a 9,900 to 19,900 won package, and a referral partnership with labor attorneys) is not built. The reason: the worth case found that writing employment-insurance documents for a person's own case for money is work that 공인노무사법 제2조①2호 and 제27조① reserve to licensed labor attorneys.

The '고용센터 제출용 의견서 초안' named in the request is delivered as DC-05 퇴직 경위 진술서, a fill-in form. Name, dates, the matching 별표 2 item with its legal text, and the list of attached evidence are filled in from what the person entered. The person writes in their own words what happened. No model writes sentences, and there is no model key in the vault.

The '판정' the request names is shown as a likelihood, never a verdict. The three wordings are 요건에 맞아 보여요, 더 확인이 필요해요 and 요건에 못 미쳐요. Every answer shows the legal text it came from, and the screens say that the 고용센터 makes the actual decision.
The '정정 요청서' the request names is DC-06, a letter template with no legally required form. The '발급 요청서' is DC-02, built on the official form (별지 제75호의3서식) and its fields.

No account and no sign-in. Everything entered, including health, family, harassment and union details, stays only in this phone's browser and can be wiped in one step (PV-01). That is why there is no separate consent screen for sensitive data.

The product never asks for a resident registration number. The issue request asks only for date of birth. The 근로복지공단 confirmation claim (별지 제20호서식) needs that number, so the product does not fill it in. Instead NX-01 says where and how to submit it.
The product is a phone-sized web page with four tabs at the bottom, and people can start without signing up.

The route to a person goes only to free public help lines (1350, ai.moel.go.kr, 서울노동권익센터, 청소년·청년근로권익센터, 경기도 스마트 마을노무사) and the 한국공인노무사회 directory of labor attorneys. There is no paid referral, which 공인노무사법 제27조의2 forbids.

The 180-day basic requirement is an estimate, and the screen says the exact count is in the 고용24 insured-period record. The minimum-wage check leans toward '더 확인이 필요해요' because some allowances are not counted. For workplaces under 5 employees, or when the size is unknown, the 연장근로 check (and 3의2호) goes to '더 확인이 필요해요'.
Feel: calm and not alarming, accurate like an official document, and written in friendly 해요체. Red is used only for deadlines and for the warning that writing something untrue counts as benefit fraud.

Things off the main path that are not built (frame section 10): automatic lookup of 고용24 processing status (the product only opens the 고용24 address and says so) and sending documents to the company for the person (they send it themselves by email, text or print).

Nothing is listed as not real. The frame's sections 2 and 10 found every item on the main path and read it: the full 별표 2 text from law.go.kr, the numeric thresholds, the fields of the official forms, the deadlines, the code table and the help lines. None of the four arms in `sz-eyes arm list` is needed, so no key is needed from the owner. No 'sz-eyes web' or other browser command was run in this pass, so the sandbox stopped nothing.
